annotations.title: Facebook data: pages, posts, reviews, events

description: One node for public Facebook pages: profile, latest posts, comments, reviews, plus local event search and the Meta ad library. Each action has its own price. Use it when: A task needs public Facebook data: checking a business page, watching what a brand posts or advertises, reading comments or reviews, or finding events. Not for: Personal profiles, private groups, Marketplace or messages. Returns: Depends on the action; see the actions table. Typical time: about 35 s. Actions: page (a page's profile, followers, category and contact details; needs handle); posts (a page's latest 10 posts; needs handle); comments (20 comments on a post or reel; needs url); reviews (20 reviews of a page; needs handle); events (10 public events for a search like jazz austin; needs query); ads (20 active facebook and instagram ads for a brand or keyword; needs query). Price: from $0.013 per call, charged only on success. Price depends on action: page $0.013, ads $0.022, posts $0.057, reviews $0.057, comments $0.057, events $0.138 (default page). One call = one Facebook action (page, posts, comments, reviews, events or ads).

action.description: What to do; sets the price. page (needs handle), posts (needs handle), comments (needs url), reviews (needs handle), events (needs query), ads (needs query). Default page

country.description: Two-letter country code, uppercase, e.g. US, GB, DE; default US (for: ads)

handle.description: Facebook page name as in its URL, e.g. natgeo (for: page, posts, reviews)

query.description: What and where, e.g. jazz Austin (for: events, ads)

url.description: A public Facebook post or reel URL (for: comments)
